[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Smoothie: Blend fruits, yogurt, and milk.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Breakfast burrito: Scramble eggs, add cheese, salsa, and fillings, wrap in a tortilla, and microwave.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Muffin tin frittatas: Whisk eggs, milk, and veggies, pour into muffin tins, and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes.
